name: What are custom baseboards and how do they differ from standard options?

mainEntity.name: What are custom baseboards and how do they differ from standard options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom baseboards are architectural trim elements tailored to specific design preferences, materials, and dimensions for a home. Unlike standard, pre-fabricated options that come in limited profiles and heights, custom baseboards offer unique designs, higher-quality woods, and precise sizing to match a room's aesthetic. This allows for seamless integration with existing architecture or the creation of a distinct new style, enhancing the overall finish and value of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom baseboards are tailored trim elements designed to specific preferences, offering unique designs and precise sizing unlike standard pre-fabricated options.
